subject.title: xurl skill: add confirm-before-post enforcement and audit log instructions

question: Should OpenClaw harden the currently bundled xurl skill with confirm-before-write and redacted audit guidance, externalize xurl instead, or require a generic hard approval/audit boundary before changing the skill text?
rationale: The requested behavior touches public account writes and private DMs, while repository docs say SKILL.md prompt guardrails are advisory rather than hard enforcement, so automation should not choose the permanent security boundary alone.

options.title: Approve bundled skill hardening
options.body: Add explicit confirm-before-write, redacted audit, and backoff guidance to `skills/xurl/SKILL.md` while xurl remains bundled, with privacy-conscious wording and focused review.

options.title: Resolve by externalizing xurl
options.body: Treat xurl as optional ClawHub/plugin-owned surface and close this issue only after the removal or package handoff lands with equivalent safety guidance in the external package.

options.title: Require hard policy first
options.body: Defer skill wording until a generic OpenClaw approval/audit mechanism for high-impact CLI write actions is designed and approved.

recommendation.title: Approve bundled skill hardening
recommendation.body: Add explicit confirm-before-write, redacted audit, and backoff guidance to `skills/xurl/SKILL.md` while xurl remains bundled, with privacy-conscious wording and focused review.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the recent maintainer-side contributor on bundled-skill trimming and release/package surfaces that determine whether xurl remains bundled.
